name: dumbbell squat lunges jump complex
description: A leg-burning chain of squat, lunge and jump with dumbbells for strength and conditioning.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
